description: Fetch up to 50 documents by CELEX in one call (batch size is clamped to the plan: FREE 1, STARTER 5, PROFESSIONAL 20, higher 50). Per-document failures are listed in errors; documents without published text stay in documents with textAvailability. Same per-document cost as lex_get_document (1 / 4 / 5 credits); trimmed items are not charged.

items.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

articleId.description: Return only this article of each document.

include.description: Only these parts. "paragraphs" = judgment grounds / text of documents without articles.

language.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

maxChars.description: Character budget shared by all documents.

view.description: Per document. Default: outline, except when articleId or include is given (then those parts are returned).

name: lex_get_documents_batch
title: Fetch several EU documents
